messages.text: Do you know of the toroidal fields generated by vocal expressions?

As of my knowledge cutoff in October 2023, there is no scientific evidence or widely accepted theory supporting the idea that vocal expressions generate toroidal fields. In physics, toroidal fields are doughnut-shaped fields commonly associated with magnetic confinement in fusion reactors or certain electromagnetic phenomena.

If you're referring to patterns created by sound waves, such as in cymatics, sound vibrations can produce intricate shapes in mediums like sand or water. These patterns are typically two-dimensional and don't specifically form toroidal shapes.

If you have more context or specific sources related to toroidal fields generated by vocal expressions, please share them. I'd be happy to discuss further or help clarify any information.
